sessions.transcript:
[user] Quick context dump before you start on Vantar Labs platform work.
[user] The nightly ETL freeze window is 02:15 to 02:45 UTC every day, nothing heavy runs then.
[user] Our primary warehouse is quartz-dw on Snowflake, hosted in eu-central.
[user] The CI deploy token is rotated every 45 days by the platform team.
[user] Service inksync owns the docs pipeline, its SLA is 99.5%.
[user] On-call rotation is 7 days with handover on Thursdays at 16:00 IST.
[user] P1 pages go to #vantar-p1-sev, P2 just goes into the ticketing queue.
[user] Never restart the legacy billing job atlas-batch before 09:00 UTC.
[user] Feature flags live in brindle and the default flag state must always be off.
[assistant] Noted all of that.

[user] More Vantar context, policy updates this week.
[user] HTTP retry budget is 3 attempts with a 250ms base backoff.
[user] The analytics events table is append-only and schema changes need a 2 week deprecation notice.
[user] Namespace prod-eu caps memory at 48 GiB per pod.
[user] Cost reviews happen on the first Tuesday of every month.
[user] Any new dependency needs a license scan by legal before merge.
[user] Halcyon Freight is our custom SLA customer, 99.9% with a 4 hour restore target.
[user] Support macro FR-17 is the only approved reply for delayed webhooks.
[user] Secrets live in Vault path kv/vantar/prod and never in env files.

[user] Incident learnings and a few changes since last time.
[user] The inksync retry storm in Sept 2026 came from a 10 second client timeout.
[user] After that incident we raised the client timeout to 30 seconds.
[user] Snowflake query tag vantar-nightly identifies batch workloads for cost attribution.
[user] The 45 day token rotation once failed because the vault policy expired at 60 days.
[user] New rule: every P1 needs a written timeline within 24 hours.
[user] We decommissioned the staging cluster kestrel in Oct 2026, it is now kestrel-2.
[user] Analytics backfills are limited to 90 days per request.
[user] Release trains leave on Tuesdays and Fridays at 11:00 IST.

questions.q: What is the nightly ETL freeze window?
Which service owns the docs pipeline and what is its SLA?
How often is the CI deploy token rotated?
Where do P2 incidents go?
What is the HTTP retry budget and base backoff?
What is the pod memory cap in prod-eu?
When do cost reviews happen?
Which support macro is approved for delayed webhooks?
How long a deprecation notice do analytics schema changes need?
What replaced the staging cluster kestrel?
What is the client timeout now, and what was it before the retry storm?
questions.a: 30 seconds now, raised from 10 seconds after the Sept 2026 retry storm

questions.q: How long is the on-call rotation and when is handover?
What is Halcyon Freight's SLA and restore target?
Which Snowflake query tag marks batch workloads?
How many days of analytics backfill can be requested at once?
When do release trains leave?
The atlas-batch job failed at 08:40 UTC. Can we restart it right away?
questions.a: No, it must not be restarted before 09:00 UTC

questions.q: We want to add a new dependency and ship on the next release train the same day. Allowed?
questions.a: Only if legal's license scan completes before merge; trains leave Tue/Fri 11:00 IST

questions.q: A P1 fires on a Thursday evening. Who gets paged and what must exist within 24 hours?
questions.a: #vantar-p1-sev gets paged, and a written timeline is required within 24 hours

questions.q: For the monthly cost review, how do we isolate batch spend in Snowflake?
questions.a: Filter on the vantar-nightly query tag during the first-Tuesday cost review

questions.q: Can we bring back the old kestrel cluster to run a 120 day analytics backfill?
questions.a: No on both counts: kestrel is decommissioned (now kestrel-2) and backfills cap at 90 days

questions.q: Why did the last token rotation fail, and what should we check in Vault?
questions.a: The vault policy expired at 60 days while rotation runs every 45 days, so the policy must outlive rotation
